name: Charles Cook
bio: Charles Cook came to Medora from Milbank in the fall of 1884 and in November opened a confectionery in one of Fisher's new buildings. He sold candy, nuts, fruit, tobacco, pipes, stationery and valentines, and in May 1885 the paper praised the trade he had built and the awning he put up. In October 1885 he left for Helena and Butte to look for a new location, and by January 1886 he had started a drug store in the Red Mountain mining district north of Helena.
